description.zh: 在上帝视角的小岛上投放草、兔、狐、蘑菇和蚯蚓，看种群曲线实时起伏。移走一种动物，让整座岛在连锁反应里复苏或崩溃——食物链，一环都别断。
description.en: Stock a tiny island with grass, rabbits, foxes, mushrooms, and earthworms, then watch the population curves swing in real time. Remove one species and the whole island blooms or collapses — every link in the food web matters.
